name: Concentric Policies
summary: Advocates for data-driven policies against non-communicable diseases, starting with higher tobacco taxes in high-burden countries.

spending.source: Concentric Policies, Marginal funding for the single best health policy in the world (EA Forum post by its founders, November 2024), https://forum.effectivealtruism.org/posts/zdacfpQdQjfGNoavQ/marginal-funding-for-the-single-best-health-policy-in-the: "Y1 Expenditure: ~$80,000 (salaries, travel, fiscal sponsorship fees)" for about October 2023 to September 2024, unaudited; the programme share (85%) is our judgment, as no split is published

lines.label: Tobacco and alcohol tax advocacy and technical help to governments in Liberia and Guinea-Bissau
lines.source: https://forum.effectivealtruism.org/posts/zdacfpQdQjfGNoavQ/marginal-funding-for-the-single-best-health-policy-in-the (first year: 8.1 months of full-time work on Liberia, 3.4 on Guinea-Bissau; one model with a branch per country and change)
